settings.name: USE_REPORTING_SMTP
settings.description: Enable sending the report via email.

settings.name: USE_REPORTING_WEBHOOK
settings.description: Enable sending the report via webhook.

settings.name: REPORTING_SCHEDULE
settings.description: The frequency at which reports are sent.

settings.name: REPORTING_TOP_N
settings.description: Number of entries shown in 'Top' tables (IPs, AS, reasons, countries, URIs and offenders). Range: 1-50. Values are clamped at runtime; the upstream metric caps at rank 50 per server.

settings.name: REPORTING_WEBHOOK_URLS
settings.description: List of webhook URLs to receive the report in Markdown (separated by spaces).

settings.name: REPORTING_SMTP_EMAILS
settings.description: List of email addresses to receive the report in HTML format (separated by spaces).

settings.name: REPORTING_SMTP_HOST
settings.description: The host server used for SMTP sending.

settings.name: REPORTING_SMTP_PORT
settings.description: The port used for SMTP. Please note that there are different standards depending on the type of connection (SSL = 465, TLS = 587).

settings.name: REPORTING_SMTP_FROM_EMAIL
settings.description: The email address used as the sender. Note that 2FA must be disabled for this email address.

settings.name: REPORTING_SMTP_FROM_USER
settings.description: The user authentication value for sending via the from email address.

settings.name: REPORTING_SMTP_FROM_PASSWORD
settings.description: The password authentication value for sending via the from email address.

settings.name: REPORTING_SMTP_SSL
settings.description: Determine whether or not to use a secure connection for SMTP.

settings.name: REPORTING_SMTP_SUBJECT
settings.description: The subject line of the email.
